items.label: Hours
items.value: Large public bath: 13:00–9:30 the next day (closed 23:00–23:30 and 9:30–13:00 for cleaning) / Open-air bath: 13:00–23:00

items.label: Amenities
items.value: Bath and face towels are provided in your room. Shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and lotion are provided in the bathing area. You may move around the hotel in your yukata.

items.label: Usage Notes
items.value: Guests with tattoos, or who have recently consumed alcohol, are asked to refrain from bathing. To prevent overheating, we recommend staying hydrated.
